mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_execution WHERE task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE export_tasks SET status='RUNNING',version=version+1 WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE task_execution SET lease_until=#{now},heartbeat_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{taskId}

UPDATE export_tasks SET status=#{status},finished_at=#{now},result_artifact_id=#{artifactId},file_name=#{fileName},file_size=#{size},error_code=#{code},error_summary=#{message},version=version+1 WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE task_execution SET progress_version=progress_version+1 WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
UPDATE export_tasks SET processed_count=GREATEST(processed_count,#{processed}),version=version+1 WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status='RUNNING' AND #{processed}<=total_count
